items.headline: Robinson, Wilder combine for 255 yards rushing and 3 scores to lead Southern Miss over UL Monroe
items.description: — Steven Robinson and Jamarice Wilder each ran for more than 100 yards and combined for three touchdowns to lead Southern Miss to a 35-21 victory over Louisiana-Monroe on Saturday.

items.headline: Robinson, Wilder help Southern Miss run past Louisiana-Lafayette 35-31
items.description: — Steven Robinson ran for three touchdowns and Jamarice Wilder raced 16 yards for the winning touchdown with 58 seconds to play and Southern Miss pulled out a 35-31 win over Louisiana-Lafayette on Saturday night.

items.headline: Arkansas State grinds out 23-13 win over Southern Miss
items.description: — Clune Van Andel kicked three field goals and Arkansas State wore down Southern Mississippi for a 23-13 victory on Saturday night.
